topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text:
The rain was just starting to let up when I got the call. A voice, tense as a wire taut in the night, tells me about a flight delay, an event missed, and a knot of worry that's bigger than the fog rolling in off the bay. I lean back, the creak of my chair a familiar lullaby. "I get it, I get it," I say, already spinning the possibilities in my head, the angles, the connections. A missed flight, sure, but what's the real story here? There's always more to it, always a reason folks come to me when the ordinary solutions run dry. "I can't promise miracles," I tell him, but the corners of my lips turn up a fraction. "But I can promise I'll find a way to straighten this out. You leave it to me."
